source: lib/ingredient-pages/creatine.ts and the three creatine reviews in lib/articles (Bulk, Myprotein, Optimum Nutrition)

lines.text: Creatine is the best-studied sports supplement there is. Here is what it does, exactly how to take it, the myths, and the three powders we have reviewed.
lines.say: Creatine is the best-studied sports supplement there is. Here is what it does, exactly how to take it, the myths, and the three powders we have reviewed.

lines.text: The short answer. 3 to 5 grams of plain creatine monohydrate a day, alongside resistance training, adds a little extra strength, power and muscle. It does nothing for endurance.
lines.say: The short answer. Three to five grams of plain creatine monohydrate a day, alongside resistance training, adds a little extra strength, power and muscle. It does nothing for endurance.

lines.text: How does it work? Your muscles store creatine to rebuild energy during short, all-out efforts. A supplement raises that store by about 20%, so you can squeeze out a rep or two more.
lines.say: How does it work? Your muscles store creatine to rebuild energy during short, all-out efforts. A supplement raises that store by about twenty percent, so you can squeeze out a rep or two more.

lines.text: What does that buy you? Across 69 trials and nearly 2,000 people, creatine added about 1.4 kilograms to the bench press and 5.6 to the squat, on top of training alone.
lines.say: What does that buy you? Across sixty-nine trials and nearly two thousand people, creatine added about one point four kilograms to the bench press and five point six to the squat, on top of training alone.

lines.text: Keep that in proportion. The gain comes through the extra training. Without training, there is little to gain.
lines.say: Keep that in proportion. The gain comes through the extra training. Without training, there is little to gain.

lines.text: Now, how to take it. Step one: buy plain creatine monohydrate powder. No other form has done better in trials, and micronised is the same thing, ground finer.
lines.say: Now, how to take it. Step one: buy plain creatine monohydrate powder. No other form has done better in trials, and micronised is the same thing, ground finer.

lines.text: Step two: take 3 to 5 grams a day, every day. Timing matters much less than consistency, so take it with whatever makes it a habit.
lines.say: Step two: take three to five grams a day, every day. Timing matters much less than consistency, so take it with whatever makes it a habit.

lines.text: Step three is optional. Loading with 20 grams a day, split into four doses, for five to seven days fills your muscles in about a week. 3 grams a day gets to the same level in about four weeks.
lines.say: Step three is optional. Loading with twenty grams a day, split into four doses, for five to seven days fills your muscles in about a week. Three grams a day gets to the same level in about four weeks.

lines.text: Step four: know what to expect. The scale often rises by 1 to 2 kilograms in the first week. That is mostly water drawn into muscle, not fat.
lines.say: Step four: know what to expect. The scale often rises by one to two kilograms in the first week. That is mostly water drawn into muscle, not fat.

lines.text: What to skip. Gummies can fail: in one test of 12 creatine gummy products, 5 failed, and 3 contained no creatine at all. Pre-workout blends often contain only 1 to 2 grams.
lines.say: What to skip. Gummies can fail: in one test of twelve creatine gummy products, five failed, and three contained no creatine at all. Pre-workout blends often contain only one to two grams.

lines.text: Does it cause hair loss? That traces to one 2009 study of 20 rugby players. A 2025 trial of 5 grams a day for 12 weeks found no change in hair, or in the hormone DHT.
lines.say: Does it cause hair loss? That traces to one two thousand and nine study of twenty rugby players. A twenty twenty-five trial of five grams a day for twelve weeks found no change in hair, or in the hormone D H T.

lines.text: Is it safe for your kidneys? In healthy people, a review of the kidney studies found no change in kidney markers. But it can nudge a blood test, so tell your doctor you take creatine before one.
lines.say: Is it safe for your kidneys? In healthy people, a review of the kidney studies found no change in kidney markers. But it can nudge a blood test, so tell your doctor you take creatine before one.

lines.text: Ask a doctor first if you have kidney disease, diabetes that affects your kidneys, or take medicines that strain the kidneys. Avoid it in pregnancy and breastfeeding unless your doctor advises otherwise.
lines.say: Ask a doctor first if you have kidney disease, diabetes that affects your kidneys, or take medicines that strain the kidneys. Avoid it in pregnancy and breastfeeding unless your doctor advises otherwise.

lines.text: What about your brain? Memory and mood benefits are promising but unproven. The European food safety authority found no established effect at 3 grams a day.
lines.say: What about your brain? Memory and mood benefits are promising but unproven. The European food safety authority found no established effect at three grams a day.

lines.text: So which one? We have reviewed three plain creatine powders, and they contain the same compound. The difference is price.
lines.say: So which one? We have reviewed three plain creatine powders, and they contain the same compound. The difference is price.

lines.text: Myprotein Impact Creatine scored highest, at 8.6 out of 10. 3 grams of creatine per serving, and about £3.20 per 100 grams on offer.
lines.say: My protein Impact Creatine scored highest, at eight point six out of ten. Three grams of creatine per serving, and about three pounds twenty per hundred grams on offer.

lines.text: Bulk Creatine Monohydrate scored 8.2, and was the cheapest we saw, at about £2.60 per 100 grams.
lines.say: Bulk Creatine Monohydrate scored eight point two, and was the cheapest we saw, at about two pounds sixty per hundred grams.

lines.text: Optimum Nutrition Micronised Creatine scored 7.4. Same dose, same compound, but about twice the price at list.
lines.say: Optimum Nutrition Micronised Creatine scored seven point four. Same dose, same compound, but about twice the price at list.

lines.text: Our rule of thumb: divide the price by the pack weight. Around £3 per 100 grams or less is good value.
lines.say: Our rule of thumb: divide the price by the pack weight. Around three pounds per hundred grams or less is good value.

lines.text: So. Plain monohydrate, 3 to 5 grams a day, every day, with training. Expect modest gains and a little water weight. Full reviews are at sharpandlean.com. This is general information, not medical advice.
lines.say: So. Plain monohydrate, three to five grams a day, every day, with training. Expect modest gains and a little water weight. Full reviews are at sharp and lean dot com. This is general information, not medical advice.
